item.title: Netflix closes 2025 with record growth, all-cash Warner deal, and AI push
item.description: Netflix closed 2025 with numbers that reaffirm its dominance and signal that the company is evolving beyond streaming alone. Revenue rose 17.6 percent in the fourth quarter, reaching $12.05 billion, driven by price adjustments, ad sales, and a subscriber base that now exceeds 325 million paid users worldwide.Read Entire Article

item.title: Lasers could soon keep military drones flying indefinitely
item.description: PowerLight recently confirmed that its laser-powered technology is approaching a crucial phase in its development cycle, with real-world deployment capabilities for the US Army now in sight. The company has successfully tested the system's core components, which are designed to wirelessly recharge drones while they remain airborne.Read Entire Article

item.title: Nvidia G-Sync Pulsar Tested: A Massive Leap in LCD Clarity
item.description: Nvidia's new G-Sync Pulsar takes gaming motion clarity to a new level. After hands-on testing, we break down how its advanced strobing, VRR support, and rolling scan work together to deliver elite results.Read Entire Article

item.title: AMD adds one-click AI tool installer to its Adrenalin GPU drivers
item.description: AMD's latest Adrenalin Edition drivers introduce an optional AI Bundle that enables one-click installation of local AI tools such as PyTorch on Windows, ComfyUI, and Ollama. The bundle aims to simplify AI workflows on supported Radeon and Ryzen AI chips while reducing setup time and cloud dependence.Read Entire Article
